description: One dataset with experience records (tour/activity listings and details) and traveler review records. Every record has recordType, scrapedAt and a direct Viator URL.

records.description: Dataset containing experience records and, in getReviews mode, review records. Fields that Viator does not publish for a record are omitted rather than returned empty.
